title: A typo in a sentence is fixed on space
Two spaces end the sentence
The next word is predicted
Backspace right after a fix puts the word back
A space after a number brings the letters back
Holding delete clears words
input: one two three four five six (hold ⌫ 2.5s)

title: Sliding on the space bar moves the cursor
input: hello world, glide left, type x

title: Return starts a new line
Shorthand expands
A sum in a message offers the answer
Asked for your address, it is one tap away
Asked for your UPI, it is one tap away
A rough message offers Tidy this up
input: ya ok will send the deck before six tmrw ␣
outcome: chip “Tidy this up” → the six versions stream in, each as soon as it is written

title: Hold space: pick the Professional version
input: ya ok will send deck b4 6
outcome: Basic · Professional · Polite · Shorter · Hinglish · Emoji, streamed in → “Understood. I will send the deck by 6 PM.”

title: Holding a version copies it instead
input: sry running late traffic is crazy (hold Basic)
outcome: message untouched; strip offers “Paste Sorry, I am running late…”

title: Hold space on a place search sends places
outcome: Insert → the places, with a link

title: Hold space on a trailer sends the video
Hold space on a currency sum answers it
Hold space with nothing typed opens Ask
g opens the tool menu, not Vault
outcome: 13 tools: Search, Rewrite, Translate, Vault, Clipboard, Emoji, Ask, Voice, My glyfs, Shorthand, Keys, Pay, Settings

title: Menu → Vault card types the detail

input: copy “Flight AI 2021 lands at 6:40, gate 12” → g → Clipboard
outcome: “Paste what you copied” on top → pasted, then kept in history

title: The direction can be changed

outcome: video card → link in the message

title: Hold T to translate
Hold S for Vault

Strip tools open in one tap

title: The GIF tab shows GIFs and copies one
input: emoji key → GIF → Trending → tap a GIF
outcome: “GIF copied. Hold the text box and tap Paste”, a com.compuserve.gif on the pasteboard; pasted into a Messages draft it shows as an image. Run against qa/fake-klipy.mjs (no KLIPY key yet)

title: The Stickers tab shows stickers and copies one
input: emoji key → Stickers → Trending → tap a sticker
outcome: “Sticker copied…”, the sticker GIF on the pasteboard; without a KLIPY key the tab shows Noto animated emoji instead

title: GIF search shows results for the word
input: emoji key → GIF → tap Search KLIPY → type “cat” → return
outcome: the grid shows the cat GIF under “CAT”; KLIPY's autocomplete appears as chips while typing

title: Make a glyf from an idea and hold its key
input: Build → “Say no, politely” → key N → Save; then “hey can u send the report tmrw morning thx”, hold N
outcome: “Sorry, I won’t be able to send it tomorrow morning. Thanks for understanding!” replaces the message

title: Onboarding, then the guided tour
input: Set up → details → sounds, clipboard, screenshots (photo permission) → turn on → switch to Glyf → nearby → the tour: tap the 870 chip, the address chip, hold space and pick a version, pick an emoji
outcome: All four tour levels done on real keys, 80 to 94 seconds a run; passed 8 of the last 8 runs. The Google step is left out while Google sign-in isn’t set up.

title: New Event from the keyboard's calendar lands in the calendar
input: hold C → + → Title “lunch with sam tomorrow 1pm” → Add → tap the event
outcome: The strip read “Fri, Sep 25, 1:00–2:00 PM”; the event is in the day's list and the message got “📅 Lunch with sam · Fri, Sep 25, 1:00–2:00 PM”

title: A plan in a message offers Add to calendar
outcome: Chip “Dinner · Tomorrow 8:00 PM” with Add; it opened New Event filled in at 8:00 PM

title: A Meet link, then a time on a Cal.com page
input: Google connected (stand-in), booking link cal.com/rick → hold C → camera; hold C → Book a time → first time → Return → Send the link
outcome: “Join me on a call: https://meet.google.com/…”, then “How about Fri, Sep 25 at 11:30 AM? Book it here: https://cal.com/rick/30min?…&slot=…” in the same message (stand-ins for Google and Cal.com)

title: A Meet-only grant: the event on the phone with a Meet link
input: Google Meet granted, Calendar unticked (stand-in) → hold C → + → “sync tomorrow 4pm” → Video call → Share in chat off → Add → tap the event
outcome: No Invitees row; “📅 Sync · Sat, Sep 26, 4:00–5:00 PM · https://meet.google.com/…” in the day's list and then the message

title: Book a time on your page for someone, with a guest

outcome: “Booked for Fri, Sep 25, 10:00 AM. The invite is on its way to sam@example.com and ria@example.com. Call: https://app.cal.com/video/bk_1” (stand-in Cal.com, which recorded Sam Lee plus the guest)

title: A Meet link from the calendar, with Google connected
outcome: “Join me on a call: https://meet.google.com/llq-kjkt-aiv”: the person's own Meet link, made by the keyboard itself

title: New Event with a guest goes to Google Calendar, which invites them

outcome: The event went to Google Calendar for sam@example.com with sendUpdates=all and a Meet call; the message got “📅 Review · Fri, Sep 25, 3:00–4:00 PM · https://meet.google.com/…”

outcome: The camera put nothing in; no Invitees or Video call row; the message got “📅 Lunch with sam · Sat, Sep 26, 1:00–2:00 PM”
